title: Uniform Local Tabularity in Intuitionistic Logic
summary: By contrast with S4, the analysis of local tabularity above IPC has provided a difficult challenge. This paper studies a strengthening of local tabularity - uniform local tabularity - where one demands that all formulas be equivalent to formulas of a given implication depth. Algebraically, this amounts to considering Heyting algebras generated by finitely many iterations of the implication operation.
